theme: Myth-busting: common misconceptions about mutual funds, addressed simply
headline: Mutual Funds Need Large Lump Sums to Start
body: Myth: You need lakhs to begin. Reality: Systematic investment plans let you start with small amounts and build gradually over time.
caption: Many believe investing requires massive upfront capital. Structured investment approaches make wealth building accessible to everyone. Start your journey today with consistent, disciplined investing. #MutualFundMyths #InvestingForAll #WealthBuilding #SmartInvesting #DebunkedMyths
